pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-treemap against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-chart-treemap id="c" label="Выручка по направлениям, млн ₽" x="name" y="value" group="area" y-format="integer"></sf-chart-treemap>
<sf-chart-treemap id="f" label="Бюджет отдела, тыс. ₽" x="item" x-label="Статья" y-format="integer" table="hidden"></sf-chart-treemap>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the total and the count of parts, the largest part and the largest group with their shares; a rectangle per part in a group of its own colour, the groups' names in bands and in the key
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.x, settings.y, settings.group, settings.labels, settings.summary, settings.legend

steps.script: (() => { document.querySelector('#c').items = [{"name": "Смартфоны", "value": 420, "area": "Электроника"}, {"name": "Ноутбуки", "value": 310, "area": "Электроника"}, {"name": "Наушники", "value": 120, "area": "Электроника"}, {"name": "Планшеты", "value": 90, "area": "Электроника"}, {"name": "Мебель", "value": 260, "area": "Дом"}, {"name": "Посуда", "value": 110, "area": "Дом"}, {"name": "Текстиль", "value": 70, "area": "Дом"}, {"name": "Обувь", "value": 180, "area": "Одежда"}, {"name": "Верхняя одежда", "value": 150, "area": "Одежда"}, {"name": "Аксессуары", "value": 60, "area": "Одежда"}]; document.querySelector('#f').items = [{"item": "Зарплаты", "amount": 5200}, {"item": "Аренда", "amount": 1400}, {"item": "Реклама", "amount": 900}, {"item": "Программы", "amount": 450}, {"item": "Обучение", "amount": 300}, {"item": "Связь", "amount": 120}, {"item": "Прочее", "amount": 80}, {"item": "Возврат", "amount": null}]; return true; })()

Больше всего — «Смартфоны»: 420 (23,7 %). Групп: 3, крупнейшая — «Электроника»: 940 (53,1 %).' && groups === 'Электроника:4|Дом:3|Одежда:3' && keys === 'Электроника|Дом|Одежда' && document.querySelector('#c .sf-chart-treemap-group.sf-chart-treemap-c1').dataset.group === 'Электроника'; })()

checks.title: the arrows walk the parts largest first, each said with its group, value and share; Down goes to the next group's first part; End goes to the last part; Enter chooses it; Escape clears
checks.covers: keyboard.host (ArrowRight, ArrowDown, End, Enter, Escape), events.select
